info.title: Cortex Code Local Server API
info.description: Loopback-only HTTP/SSE surface for local Cortex Code sessions.

rules: OpenAPI is the source of truth for every implemented route and method.
Compatibility aliases are additive and must not remove existing stable paths.
New route families should converge on reference-compatible naming and shapes.
Responses use stable object schemas with explicit required fields.
Identifiers are treated as opaque strings across HTTP, SSE, ACP, and SDK surfaces.
Schema changes require additive evolution or explicit migration notes.
Event names remain stable and machine-consumable.
SSE payloads carry enough identifiers to correlate with REST resources.
Legacy and compatibility event vocabularies may coexist while parity work lands.
Generated SDK clients consume this OpenAPI document as the canonical contract.
Typed event clients must reconstruct turn state from SSE without polling.
Wire-compatibility gaps remain explicit until matching route and event coverage ships.

diff.description: Unified diff to apply via git apply.

check.description: Validate only (git apply --check); never writes to disk.

reverse.description: Apply the patch in reverse (git apply --reverse).

path.description: Workspace path for the new worktree checkout.

branch.description: Branch to check out (or create) in the new worktree.

new_branch.description: Create `branch` as a new branch instead of checking out an existing one.

ref.description: Commit-ish to base the worktree on (defaults to HEAD).

force.description: Force creation even when the path is non-empty or the branch is in use.

PathInfoResponse.description: Workspace paths summary (directory/worktree/root/config) or path metadata (path/absolute/type/exists).

command.description: Program to run; defaults to $SHELL or /bin/sh.

base64.description: Interpret data as base64 raw bytes instead of UTF-8 text.

command.description: Shell command to execute in the server's session working directory.

model.description: Optional per-turn model id in fully-qualified provider/model form, for example google/gemini-2.5-flash. When omitted, the session model is used, then the server default.

directory.description: Current server workspace directory (redacted when needed).

url.description: Loopback-only URL for the shared session.

revoked.description: Whether at least one active local share was revoked.

plugin.description: Plugin identity from the configured plugin spec (redacted).

description.description: Adapter description surfaced to discovery clients.

diff.description: Unified diff of net session changes for this path.

messageId.description: Truncate the inherited transcript at this message id.

ConfigPatchRequest.description: Safe top-level config fields a client may patch.

SetAuthRequest.description: Store an API key or pre-obtained OAuth token for a provider.

Event.description: A typed Cortex event. The `kind` discriminator selects the family; payload fields are flat alongside it.

bearerAuth.description: When `cortex serve --token <TOKEN>` is configured, protected routes require `Authorization: Bearer <TOKEN>`.
